name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Onboarding Manager | Customer Onboarding Program Design & Cross-Functional Enablement
summary: Customer onboarding professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS and MarTech, owning onboarding from contract signature through go-live. Built and standardized onboarding workflows, playbooks, and CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel) at Wix and Solenzo, including 2 years directly managing a team of onboarding specialists. Owned onboarding for Birdeye's own partner/reseller program, direct, hands-on experience with the partnerships model EULER's platform is built to run. Comfortable owning process design, sales-to-CS handoffs, and customer enablement end to end.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Design, document, and continuously improve onboarding workflows and playbooks for a portfolio of B2B service clients, standardizing a repeatable process while flexing for each client's needs.
Own the primary strategic relationship for each client, running discovery and kickoff to align internal delivery with the client's defined success goals from day one.

Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel marketing-automation system, 20+ workflows spanning lead capture, qualification, appointment booking, and post-sale onboarding nurture, with defined onboarding stages and success criteria.
Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and data-hygiene protocols, the operational backbone onboarding runs on.
Deliver live training and build documentation and playbooks that translate platform capability into client-specific configuration.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across internal departments as strategic lead, translating client goals into aligned delivery plans across teams.
Built rigorous reporting frameworks tracking ROI and conversion KPIs, delivering QBRs that kept clients and internal stakeholders aligned on progress.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Owned onboarding for Birdeye's own reseller partnership program, onboarding, training, and supporting 15-20 partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) through go-live, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Sold and onboarded partners onto Birdeye's proprietary listings and data-aggregator solution, defining the standard onboarding sequence every partner's end customer went through.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to translate structured partner feedback into roadmap input, closing the loop between onboarding friction and product improvement.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction and time-to-adoption across the partner network.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (a team of 20, later a team of 8), standardizing onboarding stages, success criteria, and handoff points across a high-value client portfolio.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets, while owning the sales-to-onboarding handoff.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture and reporting across the team.
Led onboarding training and digital growth consultations, translating product capability into a working, revenue-generating setup for each client.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, then handed off structured plans to the implementation team to execute.
Guided client onboarding and API integrations, advising C-suite stakeholders on CRM adoption aligned to their growth stage.
